targets.note: A member sees the machine the computer runs on as a link.
The member presses it: a peek with Offline, the agents there, whose computer it is and Tell an admin. The Console does not open.
After Tell an admin: one quiet line, Sent to the Space's admins.
An admin presses it and goes to Console, Computers with the machine selected.
The machine's owner goes to Settings, This device.
